desc.en: A strong looking bear, covered in scars. A brave veteran of many battles among bears for tubers. Despite its terrifying appearance, the sight of it stuffing its cheeks with its spoils of war (tubers) is surprisingly cute.
desc.ja: 傷だらけの強そうなクマ。イモをめぐるクマ同士の闘争に勝ち残った歴戦の勇士。戦利品？のイモを頬張る姿は、恐ろしい外見からは想像できないほどカワイイらしい
